activities.name: Goal Setting
activities.description: Discuss and choose a desired body style (lean and toned, athletic, muscular, etc.). Record the choice as the end goal.

activities.name: Baseline Measurements
activities.description: Take starting metrics: weight, waist/hip circumference, and optional body fat percentage. These will help track progress.

activities.name: Light Cardio
activities.description: Walk on a treadmill or outdoors for 10 minutes at a comfortable pace to loosen up.

activities.name: Intro Strength Moves
activities.description: Perform 2 sets of 10 bodyweight squats and 5 push‑ups to gauge current strength without overexertion.

activities.name: Stretch & Reflect
activities.description: Gentle stretching to cool down; note how each exercise felt and any areas of weakness.

activities.name: Upper Body Evaluation
activities.description: Warm up with arm circles and light band pulls; then perform max‑rep test for push‑ups (on knees or toes) and plank hold duration. Record results.

activities.name: Low‑Intensity Cardio
activities.description: Cycle or row for 12 minutes at a steady, moderate pace.

activities.name: Mobility Cooldown
activities.description: Stretch chest, shoulders and triceps.

activities.name: Lower Body Evaluation
activities.description: Warm up with 5 minutes of easy jogging. Perform max‑rep bodyweight squats and lunges to assess leg endurance.

activities.name: Core Stability Test
activities.description: Do a side plank test on each side and record the duration you can hold proper form.

activities.name: Cooldown
activities.description: Stretch quads, hamstrings and calves.

activities.name: Flexibility & Balance
activities.description: Warm up with gentle dynamic stretches; practise single‑leg balance for 30 seconds per leg and note stability.

activities.name: Cardio Warm‑Up
activities.description: Spend 10 minutes on a stationary bike or brisk walk.

activities.name: Full‑Body Flow
activities.description: Perform a light circuit: 10 squats, 10 dumbbell or resistance band rows, 10 glute bridges. Focus on controlled movement.

activities.name: Stretch & Notes
activities.description: Cool down with full body stretches and jot down how the session felt.

activities.name: Assess Cardiovascular Endurance
activities.description: Choose an activity (jogging, cycling, rowing) and perform at a moderate pace for 20 minutes. Track perceived exertion (e.g., using the talk test).

activities.name: Core & Glute Activation
activities.description: 2 sets of 15 dead bugs, 12 clamshells per side and 20 glute bridges.

activities.name: Cooldown
activities.description: Stretch lower back, hips and glutes.

activities.name: Light Full‑Body Circuit
activities.description: Perform 2 rounds of: 15 squats, 10 incline push‑ups, 15 bent‑over rows with light weights or bands, and 20 calf raises. Rest 1 minute between exercises.

activities.name: Steady Cardio
activities.description: Take a brisk 15‑minute walk or swim at a gentle pace.

activities.name: Reflection
activities.description: Review any improvements or persistent challenges from earlier in the week.

activities.name: Active Recovery
activities.description: Engage in a gentle yoga session or leisurely hike to promote blood flow while allowing muscles to recover.

activities.name: Weekly Summary
activities.description: Summarise the week’s observations, baseline metrics and goal selection. Prepare to progress toward the chosen body style with a structured program in subsequent weeks.
